name: CHF Command Center — Swiss National Bank / Confederation liquidity desk
treasury: Federal Finance Administration (AFF/EFV) — Confederation's sight deposits at the SNB; no daily cash statement
monetary_sovereignty: full (CHF issuer; SNB balance sheet dominated by foreign-currency investments)
framework: MMT/Mosler: SNB creates CHF reserves mainly by buying foreign currency; sterilises with SNB Bills and liquidity-absorbing repos; tiered remuneration (0% up to threshold, −0.25% above) with the market rate anchored at policy − 5 bp by the absorption operations

units.note: SNB portal delivers CHF millions; display in bn (10^9) — never mix with 100m-yen JPY units

sterilisation (Bills + absorbing repos) as an explicit layer
weekly sight deposits as FX-intervention proxy
discarded: Netlify CORS proxy (ingestion runs in GitHub Actions)

central_bank.title: 1 · Central bank liquidity — SNB sight deposits, tiered remuneration, absorption (Bills + repos), FX-driven balance sheet
central_bank.equivalence_note: Sight deposits of domestic banks = reserves (weekly, Monday). Threshold system: 0% up to factor × minimum reserves, −0.25% above. SNB absorbs ~155 bn with Bills and 1-week repos at policy − 5 bp — that is the market anchor, not the policy rate.

threshold_utilisation.note: C4: DISPLAY ONLY — 'aggregate threshold headroom'. Thresholds are per bank; the aggregate ratio cannot signal scarcity (R3/R4/R5/R6). Replaced in the overlay by absorption_share. Pending: QB tier distribution (R4 claims QB Q2-2026 p.48) — verify in Phase 2

absorption_share.note: 26.9% in 2026-07 — how much of the gross reserve creation the SNB is holding back

net_liquidity.note: C9: cross-currency analogy only (Confederation = 5% of sight deposits); not in the score

fx_investments_change_pct.note: valuation + purchases; confirm purchases with fx_transactions_quarterly

fx_intervention_proxy_weekly.formula: sight_deposits_wow − bills_maturing_week (− repo maturities when known)
fx_intervention_proxy_weekly.note: C12: jump not explained by maturities = suspected FX purchases; monthly confirmation via GBI/GSGSF, quarterly via snbfxtr

bills_roll_off_4w.formula: sum(outstanding volume of snbbillshreg rows with repayment within 28 days)

balance_sheet_phase.formula: ABSORBING if absorption_stock rising 3 months; RELEASING if falling 3 months; FX_EXPANSION if fx_transactions_quarterly > 0 and sight deposits 13w up; STEADY otherwise

score.formula: weighted: sight_deposits_13w_change_pct band (±1), absorption_share level (−0.5 WATCH, −1 STRESS), supplying ops > 0 (−1), fx_intervention_proxy_weekly ≥ WATCH (+0.5)

gross_reserve_creation.note: C2: reserves the system would hold without sterilisation; NOT 'reserves minus absorption' (double counting, rejected)

bills_maturing_week.formula: sum(outstanding of snbbillshreg rows with repayment in the coming week) + repo maturities from gmges when available
bills_maturing_week.note: C12: known in advance from the register → used to explain weekly sight-deposit jumps

bills_yield_minus_saron_bps.note: C14: absorption premium; outside ±3 bp = SNB_BILLS_AUCTION_ANOMALY

fiscal.title: 2 · Treasury — Confederation cash at the SNB (proxy), MMDRC and bond auctions (AFF/EFV)
fiscal.equivalence_note: No daily statement and no monthly cash report (AFF site verified 2026-09-08: annual/budget only). Monthly 'Amounts due to the Confederation' (SNB balance sheet) + weekly MMDRC auctions + monthly bond auctions. Weight 0.10. The weekly 'other sight deposits' series is NOT a Confederation proxy (C6).

mmdrc_yield_minus_saron_bps.note: C7: negative = tier-arbitrage bid (banks above threshold prefer −0.08% to −0.25%), informational; POSITIVE = weak demand

banking.title: 3 · Banking transmission — domestic loans and mortgages, customer deposits, liquid assets, money stock
banking.equivalence_note: Monthly only (~20th). Swiss credit is 85% mortgages (housing/collateral signal); transmission read through customer deposits, bank liquid assets and the published mortgage-rate pass-through (zikrepro).

customer_deposits.label: Amounts due in respect of customer deposits — all banks

bank_liquid_assets.label: Liquid assets — all banks (mostly SNB sight deposits)

due_to_banks.label: Amounts due to banks — interbank funding

credit_impulse.note: C10: 85% mortgages → housing/collateral signal, EXCLUDED from the banking score (displayed)

transmission_signal.formula: GREEN if deposits_yoy_pct ≥ 0 and (liquid_assets_to_deposits ≥ p20 or deposits_yoy_pct > p25) and mortgage_5y_minus_policy_bps within p20–p80; RED if deposits_yoy_pct ≤ p10 or (liquid_assets_to_deposits ≤ p5 and deposits_yoy_pct ≤ p25); YELLOW otherwise. Liquid assets shrink mechanically under sterilisation (sight deposits → SNB Bills), so the liquidity leg alone never triggers RED
transmission_signal.note: C10: transmission read through deposits, bank liquidity and the mortgage-rate pass-through, not through mortgage volumes

rates.title: 4 · Rates and money market — SARON vs the tiered corridor, repo term curve, Confederation NSS curve
rates.equivalence_note: SARON daily (T-1). Market anchor = policy − 5 bp (absorbing repos). SARON compound / term repo rates lag 3 weeks (SNB) until SIX is wired. Confederation curve daily from the SNB warehouse (NSS, 11:00).

rate_above_threshold.label: Tier rate above threshold (effective floor for excess balances)

saron_minus_policy_bps.note: cross-currency alias (desk head reads spread vs policy for all currencies); classification lives on saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps

saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps.note: C3: STRESS SPREAD (primary). 0 = at the absorption anchor; +5 = at policy (friction); +10 STRESS; +20 CRISIS (special rate = +30); ≤ −10 persistent = FLOOR_LEAK (≈ −0.15%). +1 bp on 2026-09-04

sar3m_minus_saron_bps.note: term repo premium / cut-hike pricing (lagged 3 weeks)

confed_2y_minus_policy_bps.note: +13.6 bp on 2026-09-07 — market pricing of the next moves

mmdrc_3m_minus_saron_bps.note: −4 bp on 2026-09-08 (−0.083 vs −0.04): T-bills trade through SARON = safe-asset bid

friction_confirmed.formula: saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps ≥ +5 for 3 consecutive sessions (SARON at/above policy)

score.formula: CORRIDOR CALM +0.75 (spread within [−5, +3]); WATCH 0; STRESS −0.75; CRISIS −1.5; floor_leak −0.25

secondary_absolute.origin: C3: absorbing repos at policy − 5 bp anchor SARON; special rate = +30 from the anchor; −0.25% tier = −20

saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps.rule: absolute binding for STRESS/CRISIS; percentile alone caps at WATCH

regime.weights_note: v0.1 PROPOSAL: sight deposits and absorption dominate the CHF story; fiscal is small and proxied (0.10); banking 0.15 because Swiss credit (mortgages) is the domestic transmission channel and monthly data are good. To be triangulated.

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: PRICE-GATED ONLY: saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps ≥ STRESS persistent AND (supplying_repos > 0 OR mm_operations_supplied_month > 0 OR secured_loans rising); quantity anchor (excess_to_required_ratio ≤ STRESS) is a dead-man switch
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: reserves ample AND friction_confirmed (SARON at/above policy 3 sessions)
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.FX_INTERVENTION_SUSPECT: C12: sight_deposits_wow ≥ p90 (or ≥ +5000) AND (bills_maturing_week + known repo maturities) < 50% of the jump; monthly confirmation GBI/GSGSF; quarterly snbfxtr > 1000
orthogonal_flags.THRESHOLD_FACTOR_CHANGE: threshold_factor changed vs previous session (policy event; 8 cuts since 2022-07)
orthogonal_flags.FLOOR_LEAK: saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps ≤ −10 for 5 sessions (drift toward the −0.25% tier)
orthogonal_flags.ABSORPTION_INTENSITY: absorption_share level ≥ WATCH (SNB holding back an unusual share of reserves)
orthogonal_flags.BILLS_ROLL_OFF_AHEAD: bills_roll_off_4w ≥ 20% of snb_bills (liquidity returns if not rolled)
orthogonal_flags.SNB_SUPPLYING: supplying_repos > 0 or mm_operations_supplied_month > 0 (scarcity signal at 0% policy)
orthogonal_flags.MPA_WEEK: monetary policy assessment within 5 business days
orthogonal_flags.DATA_DEGRADED: quality < 70 or weekly sight deposits missing on Monday 12:00 CET
orthogonal_flags.FOREIGN_SIGHT_DEPOSITS_JUMP: other_sight_deposits_wow level ≥ WATCH (foreign banks / institutions — hot money or intervention settlement)
orthogonal_flags.REPO_ABSORPTION_CHANGE: monthly absorbed volume (gmges CT allocation) changes ≥ 25% vs prior month
orthogonal_flags.COLLATERAL_SCARCITY: saron_minus_absorption_rate_bps ≥ +5 with reserves ample AND mmdrc_yield_minus_saron_bps ≤ −10 (bills extremely rich)
orthogonal_flags.TIER_ARBITRAGE_BID: mmdrc_yield_minus_saron_bps ≤ −5 (informational: banks above threshold buying bills)
orthogonal_flags.RESERVE_PERIOD_END: calendar day 18–20 (info; excluded from persistence counts)

calibration.note: percentile windows anchored at 2025-06-20 (policy 0%) for spreads; weekly sight deposits window 260w (5y) available from the portal; min_n guard: daily 120, weekly 26, monthly 12; persistence counts exclude reserve-period end (18–20) — R5

STERILISATION_STRESS.note: C4/C5: threshold utilisation removed (per-bank thresholds unobservable); absorption share and foreign sight deposits added

dual.status: calibrated by replay 2026-09-09 (engine v0.3, era 2022-09-22, 207 weeks)

central_bank.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

fiscal.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

dual.rule: three regimes per currency (engine v0.3): central_bank and fiscal from their block score with era-calibrated entry/exit cuts on the 7-day mean score; general = agreement only (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN, partial or conflict → NEUTRAL labelled); percentile windows anchored to era_start; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

dual_v02.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

status_rules.note: weekly = Friday data on Monday (+2 days) → 9 covers a holiday Monday; zirepo term rates allowed stale 25 days by design (3-week SNB lag); quarterly snbfxtr: Q1 was still the latest on 2026-09-08 (published with the Quarterly Bulletin, ~1 quarter lag) → 200 days

reconciliation.rule: sight_deposits_domestic_weekly on month-end Friday ≈ snbbipo GB (±3%)

quality.null_policy: null is NEVER neutral: series -> unavailable; FRGSF / supplying operations empty = 0 with last-use memo

rules.note: grammar: engine has no percentile operator; confed_cash_mom is classified two-sided p90/p10 in the block, so level >= WATCH == |mom| beyond p90/p10

alerts.note: rules use the engine grammar: 'level >= X', '> n', 'abs >= pX'
